criteria.text: A `session.command` WS frame (or POST route — implementer picks one and documents it) `{id, command, arguments}` invokes the SDK command wrapper with (sdkId, command, arguments) — vitest spy assert; unknown local id → error frame.
criteria.test_id: issue-697-c1: session.command WS frame dispatches SDK wrapper / unknown id → error

criteria.text: Selecting a command in the popover and submitting sends the structured frame, NOT a `session.input` with text prefix (controller test asserts message type and absence of `/cmd` text send).
criteria.test_id: issue-697-c2: selecting command from popover sends session.command WS frame not session.input

criteria.text: The user's command invocation renders in the transcript as a distinct command row (`/name args`), and the streamed response parts render normally.
criteria.test_id: issue-697-c3: command message role renders as command row with /name args text

criteria.text: Typing `/notacommand foo` (not in `command.list`) and submitting sends plain `session.input` text (regression).
criteria.test_id: issue-697-c4: free-typed slash text not in command list sends plain session.input

criteria.text: Command failure (SDK error) surfaces as a system error message in the transcript.
criteria.test_id: issue-697-c5: SDK command failure → WS error frame → system error message in transcript
